senses.gloss: निरग्नि a. having no fire or hearth.

निरत a. satisfied with, delighting in, devoted to, intent
upon (loc., instr., or —˚).

निरञ्जन a. without unguent or paint, deceitless,
honest.

2 निरनुक्रोश a. merciless, cruel towards (loc.);
abstr. ˚ता f.

निरनुरोध a. regardless, unkind, indifferent to
(loc.).

निरपराध a. faultless, innocent (also ˚वन्त्);
abstr. ˚ता f.

निरपेक्ष a. regardless, careless, indifferent to or
about (loc. or —˚). — Abstr. निरपे˚क्षा & निरपे˚क्षता f.,
निरपे˚क्षत्व n.

निरभिलाष a. not wishing for, indifferent about
(—˚).
निरभ्र a. cloudless, loc. in a cloudless sky.
निरम्बु a. having or drinking no water.

निरर्गल a. unchecked, free;
 n. adv.
2 निरर्थ a. = seq. + destitute of wealth, poor.

निरर्थक a. purposeless, useless, unmeaning,
nonsensical.
निरवकाश a. offering or finding no space.

निरवग्रह a. unchecked, free;
 n. adv.
निरवयव a. not consisting of parts, indivisible.
निरवलम्ब a. having or offering no support.
निरवलम्ब˚न a. having or offering no support.
निरसन a. (f. ई) & n. expelling, rejecting.
निराकाङ्क्ष a. expecting or wanting nothing.
निराका˚ङ्क्षिन् a. expecting or wanting nothing.

नीराग a. colourless, passionless;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
निरातप a. not exposed to the heat of the sun.
निरानन्दकर f. ई causing woe or sorrow.
2 निरामय a. healthy, well, wholesome, perfect.

निरामिष a. having no meat or prey, free from sensual
desires.

निरालोक a. not looking about, blind (lit. & fig.);
 dark.
निराशिस् a. without a hope or blessing.

निराश्रय a. without (i.e. not having or offering)
shelter, refuge, or support.
निरास्वाद a. tasteless, yielding no enjoyment.
निरा˚स्वाद्य a. tasteless, yielding no enjoyment.

निराहार a. & m. not eating, fasting;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

नि॑रिन्द्रिय a. having no organs (of sense), impotent,
barren, weak, frail.

निरीक्षण a. = prec.;
 n. look, sight.
निरीक्षितव्य a. to be looked at or considered.
निरीक्ष्य a. to be looked at or considered.

निरीह a. inactive, indolent;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

निरुक्त a. uttered, pronounced, declared as (2 nom.),
explained, distinctly said or enjoined;
 n. explanation, etymological
interpretation, T. of a work.
निरुज a. free from sickness, healthy, whole-some.
नीरुज a. free from sickness, healthy, well.
निरुत्कण्ठ a. free from desire or longing.*

निरुत्तर a. having no superior, having or making no
reply.

निरुत्सवारम्भ a. showing no preparations for a
festival.*
1 निरुत्साह m. want of energy, indolence.

2 निरुत्साह a. devoid of energy or courage, indolent;
abstr. ˚ता f.
निरुदर a. having no belly or trunk.

निरुपद्रव a. inflicting or suffering no harm;
harmless, undisturbed.
निरुपम a. having no like, matchless.
निरूपयितव्य a. to be determined or defined.
नि˚रू॑प्य a. to be determined or defined.

निरोध m. shutting in, confinement, restraint, coercion,
oppression.

निरो॑धन a. confining, obstructing (—˚);
 n. = prec.

निरौषध a. incurable, irremediable (lit. where there
is no healing plant).

निर्गम m. going out (also ˚न n.), ceasing, vanishing,
issue, end.
निर्गलित a. flowed out, poured forth.

निर्ग्रन्थ a. freed from all ties;
 m. a Jaina beggar.

निर्घात m. removal, destruction;
 hurricane, whirlwind.

निर्घृण a. unmerciful, cruel, hard-hearted, n. adv.;
abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.

निर्जर a. not growing old;
 young, fresh.
नि॑र्जरायु a. having cast its skin (serpent).
निर्जल a. waterless, s. such a land.

निर्जीव a. lifeless, dead, ˚करण n. killing,
slaughter.
निर्णयोपमा f. a kind of comparison ((rh.)).
निर्णत a. bent outwards, projecting, high.

निर्णिक्त a. washed off, cleansed, polished, purified,
expiated.
निर्णि॑ज् f. shining dress or ornament.
निर्णीत a. found out, ascertained, settled, fixed.
निर्णेतृ m. who pronounces a sentence, judge, umpire.
निर्दश a. more than ten days old.

निर्दुःख a. feeling or causing no pain, abstr. ˚त्व
n.
नि॑र्देव a. forsaken by the gods.

निर्देश m. pointing out, direction, order, command to
(—˚), description, designation.

निर्देश्य a. to be determined, described, announced, or
foretold.
निर्दोष a. faultless, guiltless, innocent, abstr. ˚ता f.
निर्धन a. having no property, indigent, poor.
निर्धारण n. the same, determining, settling.

निर्नमस्कार a. doing or deserving no homage,
despised by all.
निर्नर a. devoid of men, deserted.

निर्नास a. noseless or snub-nosed^1.*
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
निर्निमित्त a. causeless, groundless, ˚— & n. adv.

निर्बन्ध m. insisting upon (loc. or —˚), pertinacity,
perseverance.

निर्बीज a. seedless, empty;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
निर्भी a. fearless, not afraid of (—˚).
निर्भी˚क a. fearless, not afraid of (—˚).

1 निर्भेद m. bursting, splitting asunder (tr. & intr.);
blurting or blabbing out.
निर्भोग a. not devoted to enjoyment.
निर्मत्सर a. free from envy or egoism.

निर्मथन n. stirring, churning, rubbing (esp. kindle
fire by rubbing).
निर्मनस्क a. mindless, senseless, abstr. ˚ता f.

निर्मन्त्र a. not accompanied by sacred verses (a
marriage).
निर्मातृ m. maker, builder, creator, author.
निर्मान a. free from pride or egoism.

निर्माल्य a. cast out or left (from a garland), useless;
n. the leavings of a sacrifice, esp. flowers.

नि॑र्मित a. produced, made, built, formed, created by
(instr. or —˚), out of (abl., instr. or —˚);
 effected, caused,
settled, determined.
नि॑र्मुक्ति f. liberation, deliverance from (abl. or —˚).
निर्मूल a. rootless, unfounded, abstr. ˚ता f.
निर्मोक m. a hide or skin (taken or cast off).

निर्याण n. going out or off, departure, disappearance,
death.
निर्यातन n. giving back, returning, requital.
निर्यात्य a. to be restored or delivered.
निर्यास॑ m. exudation of trees, juice, resin, milk, etc.
निर्यूह n. prominence, projection, pinnacle, turret.
निर्योगक्षेम a. neither acquiring nor enjoying.
निर्वंश a. having no family, single.

1 निर्वचन n. speaking out, utterance, saying, proverb,
explanation, etymology.
निर्व॑पण a. & n. pouring out, offering, bestowing.

निर्वश a. having no free will, dependent;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

निर्वसु a. wealthless, poor;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
निर्वाच्य a. to be explained or defined.
2 निर्वाण a. extinguished, set (sun), liberated, blessed.

निर्वात a. windless, sheltered;
 s. such a place.
निर्वाप m. scattering, strewing, pouring out, offering.
निर्वासनीय a. to be expelled or banished.
निर्वास्य a. to be expelled or banished.
निर्वाह्य a. to be accomplished or performed.

निर्विकल्प˚क a. having or offering no alternative,
free from difference or doubt;
 n. ˚ल्पम् without hesitation or
reflection.

निर्विकार a. unchanged, immutable, firm;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
निर्विघ्न a. undisturbed, n. & instr. adv.
निर्विन्ध्या f. N. of a river.

निर्विषय a. having no residence, support, or sphere;
banished, driven from (—˚).

नि॑र्वीर a. destitute of men or heroes, abstr.
निर्वीर॑ता f.

नि॑र्वीर्य a. unmanly, powerless, impotent, exhausted;
abstr. ˚ता† f.

निर्वृत a. extinct, allayed;
 satisfied, happy.

निर्वृति f. extinction, tranquillity, happiness, bliss;
poss. ˚मन्त्.

निर्वेददुःसहम् adv. in a manner unbearable to (or
on account of) despair.*
निर्वेपन a. not trembling or flickering.
निर्वेश्य a. to be paid or requited.
निर्वेष्टव्य a. to be paid or requited.

निर्वैर a. peaceable, free from enmity towards (loc.);
n. adv. & = abstr. ˚ता f.
निर्वोढृ॑ a. going to carry away.

निर्व्यपेक्ष a. regardless, indifferent to (loc. or
—˚).

निर्व्याकुल a. undisturbed, calm;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

निर्व्याज a. deceitless, honest, sincere, pure, genuine;
n. adv., abstr. ˚ता f.
निर्व्याधि a. free from sickness, healthy.
निर्व्यापार a. free from occupation, not busy.

निर्व्यूढ a. finished, successful;
 n. completion.

निर्व्यूढि f. issue, end;
 top, summit.
निर्व्रण a. free from wounds, unhurt, undam aged.
निर्हरण n. taking out or off, removing, carrying away.

निर्हेतु a. causeless;
 abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
नीरजस् a. free from dust or passion.
नीर˚जस्क a. free from dust or passion.
नीरधि m. sea, ocean (lit. receptacle of waters).
नीर˚निधि m. sea, ocean (lit. receptacle of waters).
नीराजन n. ˚ना f. a kind of lustration ((r.)).
नीरुज् a. free from sickness, healthy, well.
नीरोग a. free from sickness, healthy, well.
